## Part 1: Data Processing

```{r}
# 1) Use httr::GET to return topic information 
# using SEPT 01, 2026 as date due to 30 day Free trail restriction

url <- "https://api.census.gov/data/2021/acs/acs1/pums/variables.json"
varlist <- c("AGEP", "GASP", "GRPIP", "JWAP", "JWDP", "JWMNP", 
             "PWGTP", "FER", "HHL", "SCH", "SCHL", "SEX", 
             "REGION", "DIVISION", "ST")

unparsed_data <- httr::GET(url)
str(unparsed_data, max.level = 1)

# 2) Parse returned information for the actual article information
raw_json <- content(unparsed_data, as = "text")
raw_data <- fromJSON(raw_json)
parsed_data <- raw_data$variables

# Filter only necessary variables
# 1) create a list of variables that are both requested and present
targets <- intersect(varlist, names(parsed_data))

# 2) select matching vars from data. 
output <- parsed_data[targets]


# Function to Parse Variable Values
variable_get <- function( jsonURL, varList, outName) {
  data <- httr::GET(jsonURL)
  str(data, max.level = 1)
  
  # 2) Parse returned information for the actual article information
  raw_json <- content(data, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  parsed_data <- fromJSON(raw_json)
  
  # 3) save .RDS file to Datafolder
  saveRDS(parsed_data, file = outName)
  
}

```
